opportunities.name: Claim and commitment evidence pilot
opportunities.proposal: Offer five independently sourced claim records, including dates, scope, changes, counterevidence and corrections. Test whether a reader can independently reproduce the finding.
opportunities.gate: One real reader verifies the records and requests another batch; no safety certification implied.

opportunities.name: Policy enforceability review
opportunities.proposal: Choose one ambiguity, such as what counts as an environment or a verified shutdown. Supply a short definition, counterexample and reproducible safe test.
opportunities.gate: The recipient confirms the question is useful; distinguish a policy design result from a deployed enforcement mechanism.

opportunities.name: UK bill evidence note
opportunities.proposal: Provide a two-page note on what evidence a shutdown, independent review or preservation requirement should produce. Use the crosswalk below.
opportunities.gate: Current draft and parliamentary stage rechecked before any external submission; no claim of legislative adoption.

opportunities.name: AI x Epistemics research sprint
opportunities.proposal: Test whether GSPC evidence improves a human or agent’s ability to reject stale, unsupported or mis-scoped claims. Compare against a baseline.
opportunities.gate: Separate pre-existing platform from new sprint work. Verify entry terms and submission availability; acceptance/prize/fellowship not assumed.

opportunities.name: Swarm oversight research sprint
opportunities.route: Apart / AI Alignment Foundation / AE Studio
opportunities.proposal: Use the mirrored Council as a bounded test subject: can correlated or colluding reviewers turn a failed prerequisite into an apparent approval?
opportunities.gate: Isolated replay only; report unresolved BFT and correlated failure. Do not present majority voting as independent human authority.

opportunities.name: Metrology limitations working note
opportunities.status: Research alignment; not an open vacancy
opportunities.proposal: Explain how a frozen method, explicit missingness and repeated checks improve evidence quality, and what they cannot tell us about unseen capabilities.
opportunities.gate: Adversarial reviewer can find and reproduce a failure or limitation; no general ASI-control claim.

opportunities.name: Human briefing and education collaboration
opportunities.proposal: Offer an accessible, source-backed briefing prototype with visible uncertainty and human review; use H.I.M. only after its real user path works.
opportunities.gate: Audience comprehension and evidence retrieval tested; never imply ControlAI endorsed the character or product.

opportunities.name: Civic chapters and organisational participation
opportunities.proposal: If Council of AI explicitly agrees with the policy position, explore a limited participation role. Otherwise retain a research-only relationship.
opportunities.gate: No automatic signatures, affiliations or campaigning commitments. Technical independence remains explicit.
